name: @magpie-community/opencode-antigravity-bridge
description: Connect to Antigravity via the official agy CLI to help reduce account risk from client impersonation. Lean prompts and session reuse cut redundant context and token usage.

scripts.test: node --test test-step-usage.mjs test-usage.mjs test-compat.mjs test-platform.mjs test-prompt-guard.mjs test-tool-schema.mjs test-upstream-error.mjs test-mcp-server.mjs && node test-smoke.mjs

summary.en: Connect to Antigravity via the official agy CLI to help reduce account risk from client impersonation. Lean prompts and session reuse cut redundant context and token usage.
summary.zh: 通过官方 agy CLI 接入 Antigravity，旨在降低模拟客户端带来的封号风险；精简提示词、复用会话，减少重复上下文与 Token 消耗。
